## SvelteKit Route Structure -- Complete Analysis

### 1. Build Configuration

**`D:\code\tutors-apps\svelte.config.js`**
- Uses `@sveltejs/adapter-auto` (auto-detects deployment target).
- Preprocessor: `vitePreprocess()`.
- Suppresses the `state_referenced_locally` Svelte warning globally.
- No custom `alias`, `paths`, or CSP settings.

**`D:\code\tutors-apps\vite.config.ts`**
- Plugins: `sveltekit()` + `@tailwindcss/vite`.
- Defines a global `APP_VERSION` constant from `package.json`.
- No proxy, custom server, or environment-specific config.

---

### 2. Hooks

**`D:\code\tutors-apps\src\hooks.server.ts`** -- Server-Side Auth Hook
- Configures `@auth/sveltekit` with a GitHub OAuth provider.
- Auth base path: `/auth`.
- Provider: GitHub. The `profile()` callback maps `profile.login` (GitHub username) onto the user object.
- JWT strategy; session max age: 1 year.
- The `jwt` callback copies `user.login` into the token; the `session` callback copies `token.login` onto `session.user.login`.
- Exports a single `handle` function (the auth middleware). No `sequence()` composition with other handlers.
- Environment variables consumed: `PRIVATE_AUTH_GITHUB_SECRET`, `PRIVATE_AUTH_GITHUB_ID`, `PRIVATE_AUTH_SECRET`.

**`D:\code\tutors-apps\src\hooks.client.ts`** -- Client-Side Initialization
- Sets a global fallback `__TUTORS_TIME_SUPABASE_INIT__` with `PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` and `PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` before any other imports, so that if `getSupabase()` is called before `initSupabase()`, the library can recover.
- Calls `initSupabase(PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY)` from `@tutors/tutors-time-lib`.
- This runs before any client-side load functions.

---

### 3. Root Layout

**`D:\code\tutors-apps\src\routes\+layout.server.ts`**
- Load signature: `async ({ locals }) => { ... }`
- Calls `locals.auth()` (provided by the auth hook).
- Returns: `{ loggedIn: boolean, user: Session["user"] | undefined }`
- This data is available to every page via `parent()` or automatic cascading.

**`D:\code\tutors-apps\src\routes\+layout.svelte`**
- Props: `{ data: PageData, children: Snippet }`
- If `data.user` is truthy, calls `tutorsConnectService.reconnect(data.user)` to restore the user session on the client.
- If running in browser, calls `themeService.initDisplay()`.
- Renders `{@render children()}` with no wrapping shell (the group layouts add the shell).

---

### 4. Route Group Layouts

#### `(home)` group -- `D:\code\tutors-apps\src\routes\(home)\+layout.svelte`
- Resets `currentCourse.value = null`.
- Wraps children in `<CourseShell>` (the `TutorsShell.svelte` component).
- Sets page title to "Tutors".

#### `(course-reader)` group -- `D:\code\tutors-apps\src\routes\(course-reader)\+layout.svelte`
- Calls `tutorsConnectService.startTimer()` on mount.
- Has a `$effect` that fires on every navigation, calling `tutorsConnectService.learningEvent(page.params)`.
- On course change (when `currentCourse.value.courseId` differs from `lastCourseId`), calls `tutorsConnectService.checkWhiteList()` and `tutorsConnectService.courseVisit(currentCourse.value)`.
- After navigation, smooth-scrolls `#content-panel` into view on viewports >= 600px.
- Sets `<title>` to `currentCourse.value.title`.
- Wraps children in `<CourseShell>`.

#### `(live)` group -- `D:\code\tutors-apps\src\routes\(live)\+layout.svelte`
- Resets `currentCourse.value = null`.
- On mount, fetches `catalogueService.getCatalogueCount()` and `catalogueService.getStudentCount()` (though these values are only used locally and not passed down).
- Sets page title to "Tutors".
- Wraps children in `<CourseShell>` inside a bordered/rounded container div.

---

### 5. All Routes -- Load Functions and Page Components

#### 5.1 `(home)/` -- Home Page
- **Route**: `/`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `ssr = false`. Calls `parent()` but returns nothing (`async ({ parent }) => {}`). The page only inherits the root layout data (`loggedIn`, `user`).
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Does not receive `data` prop. Renders four sub-components: `Welcome`, `TutorsInfo`, `Links`, `CourseList`. All data for these comes from services or runes, not from the load function.

#### 5.2 `(auth)/auth` -- Sign-In (no course context)
- **Route**: `/auth`
- **Load**: None (`+page.ts` does not exist).
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Renders `<SigninWithGithub redirect={"/"} />`. No data props.

#### 5.3 `(auth)/auth/[courseid]` -- Sign-In with Redirect to Course
- **Route**: `/auth/:courseid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `async ({ params }) => { return { courseId: params.courseid }; }`
- **Returns**: `{ courseId: string }`
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: any }`. Renders `<SigninWithGithub redirect="/course/{data.courseId}" />`.

#### 5.4 `(course-reader)/course/[courseid]` -- Course Home
- **Route**: `/course/:courseid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `ssr = false`. Calls `courseService.readCourse(params.courseid, fetch)`. Sets `currentCourse.value = course`.
- **Returns**: `{ course: Course, lo: Course }` (both are the same Course object)
- **Service call**: `courseService.readCourse()` -- fetches `tutors.json`, builds and caches the course tree.
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: any }`. Renders `<Composite composite={data.course} />`.

#### 5.5 `(course-reader)/topic/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Topic View
- **Route**: `/topic/:courseid/*loid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `ssr = false`. Calls `courseService.readTopic(params.courseid, url.pathname, fetch)`.
- **Returns**: `{ topic: Topic }`
- **Service call**: `courseService.readTopic()` -- loads the course, then looks up the topic from `course.topicIndex` by URL pathname.
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: PageData }`. Renders `<Composite composite={data.topic} />`.

#### 5.6 `(course-reader)/lab/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Lab View
- **Route**: `/lab/:courseid/*loid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `ssr = false`. Calls `courseService.readLab(params.courseid, url.pathname, fetch)`. Determines whether to set the first page active or a specific page based on the last URL segment. Sets `currentLabStepIndex.value`.
- **Returns**: `{ lab: LabService }` (a `LiveLab` instance)
- **Service call**: `courseService.readLab()` -- loads the course, strips the step segment from the lab ID, looks up the lab from `course.loIndex`, converts markdown to HTML, creates/caches a `LiveLab`.
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: PageData }`. If `data.lab.lab.pdf` is truthy, renders a `TalkClient` inside `Context`; otherwise renders a `Lab` inside `Context`. Sets `hideMainNavigator` rune to `true` on mount / `false` on destroy.

#### 5.7 `(course-reader)/talk/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Talk/Presentation
- **Route**: `/talk/:courseid/*loid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `ssr = false`. Calls `courseService.readLo(params.courseid, url.pathname, fetch)`.
- **Returns**: `{ lo: Lo }`
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: PageData }`. Renders `<Context lo={data.lo}><TalkClient lo={data.lo} /></Context>`.

#### 5.8 `(course-reader)/paneltalk/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Panel Talk
- **Route**: `/paneltalk/:courseid/*loid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): Identical to talk -- `ssr = false`, calls `courseService.readLo(params.courseid, url.pathname, fetch)`.
- **Returns**: `{ lo: Lo }`
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Identical rendering to talk -- `<Context lo={data.lo}><TalkClient lo={data.lo} /></Context>`.

#### 5.9 `(course-reader)/note/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Note
- **Route**: `/note/:courseid/*loid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `ssr = false`. Calls `courseService.readLo(params.courseid, url.pathname, fetch)`.
- **Returns**: `{ lo: Lo }`
- **Service call**: `courseService.readLo()` -- if the LO type is `"note"`, also calls `markdownService.convertNoteToHtml()` and caches it.
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: PageData }`. Renders `<Context lo={data.lo}><Note lo={data.lo} /></Context>`.

#### 5.10 `(course-reader)/tutorial/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Tutorial (Note variant)
- **Route**: `/tutorial/:courseid/*loid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `ssr = false`. Calls `courseService.readLo(params.courseid, url.pathname, fetch)`.
- **Returns**: `{ lo: Lo }`
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: PageData }`. Renders `<Context lo={data.lo}>`, then `<Note lo={data.lo} />`, and conditionally `<TalkClient lo={data.lo} orientation="portrait" />` if `data.lo.pdf` is truthy.

#### 5.11 `(course-reader)/video/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Video
- **Route**: `/video/:courseid/*loid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `ssr = false`. Parses `url.searchParams` to reconstruct the video ID (handles trailing `=` in query strings). Calls `courseService.readLo(params.courseid, videoId, fetch)`.
- **Returns**: `{ lo: Lo }`
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: PageData }`. Renders `<Context lo={data.lo}><Video lo={data.lo} /></Context>`.

#### 5.12 `(course-reader)/wall/[type]/[courseid]` -- Wall (All LOs of a Type)
- **Route**: `/wall/:type/:courseid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `ssr = false`. Calls `courseService.readCourse(params.courseid, fetch)` and `courseService.readWall(params.courseid, params.type, fetch)`. Sets `currentLo.value` to a synthetic object with `breadCrumbs`, `title`, `type`, `parentLo`, `parentCourse`, `route`.
- **Returns**: `{ type: string, lo: Course, los: Lo[] }`
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: PageData }`. Renders `<Wall los={data.los} type={data.type} />`.

#### 5.13 `(course-reader)/search/[courseid]` -- Course Search
- **Route**: `/search/:courseid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `ssr = false`. Calls `courseService.readCourse(params.courseid, fetch)`. Sets `currentLo.value = course`.
- **Returns**: `{ course: Course }`
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: PageData }`. On mount, filters the course LOs into labs, steps, notes, and panel notes. Provides a text input and search button; on submit, calls `searchHits(searchLos, searchTerm)` and renders results with markdown-to-HTML conversion.

#### 5.14 `(course-reader)/time/[courseid]` -- Student Time/Calendar
- **Route**: `/time/:courseid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `ssr = false`. Calls `courseService.readCourse(params.courseid, fetch)`. Sets `currentCourse.value = course`.
- **Returns**: `{ course: Course, lo: Course }` (same object in both fields)
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: any }`. Uses a `$effect` to reactively load student time data via `TutorsTime.loadStudentTime(courseId, studentLogin, null, null)` from `@tutors/tutors-time-lib` when `currentCourse` or `tutorsId` changes. Renders `SecondaryNavigator`, `HeatMaps`, and `Tables` components.

#### 5.15 `(course-reader)/llm/[courseid]` -- LLM Documentation Links
- **Route**: `/llm/:courseid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `ssr = false`. Calls `courseService.readCourse(params.courseid, fetch)`. Sets `currentCourse.value = course`. Calls `generateLlms(course)` (from local `llms.ts`) which produces HTML links to `llms.txt` and PDF zip archives for the course and each topic.
- **Returns**: `{ course: Course, llmsLinks: string }` (llmsLinks is an HTML string)
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: any }`. If `data.course.llm === 0`, redirects to `/course/:courseid`. Otherwise renders a `SecondaryNavigator` and the LLM documentation links as HTML.

#### 5.16 `(live)/catalogue` -- Course Catalogue
- **Route**: `/catalogue`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): SSR is enabled (no `ssr = false`). Calls `catalogueService.getCatalogue()` (Supabase query on `tutors-connect-courses`). Filters entries with `visit_count >= 20`, sorts descending by visit count. Maps to course records with a `visits` field added.
- **Returns**: `{ courseRecords: Array<{ ...course_record, visits: number }> }`
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: any }`. On mount, computes `totalModules` from `data.courseRecords.length` and fetches `totalStudents` from `catalogueService.getStudentCount()`. Renders `<Catalogue courseRecords={data.courseRecords} />`.

#### 5.17 `(live)/live` -- Global Live View
- **Route**: `/live`
- **Load**: None (`+page.ts` does not exist).
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): No data props. Calls `liveService.startGlobalPresenceService()` at module level. Renders a tabbed view with three tabs: "Courses" (`liveService.coursesOnline`), "Students" (`liveService.studentsOnline`), and "Groups". All data comes from the `liveService` reactive state, not from a load function.

#### 5.18 `(live)/live/[courseid]` -- Course-Specific Live View
- **Route**: `/live/:courseid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): SSR enabled. Calls `courseService.readCourse(params.courseid, fetch)`. Sets `currentCourse.value = course`.
- **Returns**: `{ courseid: string, course: Course }`
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: { courseid: string, course: Course } }`. On mount, starts `presenceService.startPresenceListener(courseid)` and fetches `getTutorsConnectLatestLosByCourseId(courseid)` from Supabase. Uses `$derived` to partition activity into "today", "this week", "this month", "this year" buckets. Renders `CourseGroupHeader`, `ConnectLatestLosCards` for online students, and a tabbed view for historical activity.

---

### 6. Summary of Data Flow Patterns

**Service call matrix** (what each route calls):

| Route | Service Method | Returns |
|---|---|---|
| `/` | (none) | `{}` |
| `/auth` | (none) | (no data) |
| `/auth/:courseid` | (none) | `{ courseId }` |
| `/course/:courseid` | `courseService.readCourse()` | `{ course, lo }` |
| `/topic/:courseid/*` | `courseService.readTopic()` | `{ topic }` |
| `/lab/:courseid/*` | `courseService.readLab()` | `{ lab }` |
| `/talk/:courseid/*` | `courseService.readLo()` | `{ lo }` |
| `/paneltalk/:courseid/*` | `courseService.readLo()` | `{ lo }` |
| `/note/:courseid/*` | `courseService.readLo()` | `{ lo }` |
| `/tutorial/:courseid/*` | `courseService.readLo()` | `{ lo }` |
| `/video/:courseid/*` | `courseService.readLo()` | `{ lo }` |
| `/wall/:type/:courseid` | `readCourse()` + `readWall()` | `{ type, lo, los }` |
| `/search/:courseid` | `courseService.readCourse()` | `{ course }` |
| `/time/:courseid` | `courseService.readCourse()` | `{ course, lo }` |
| `/llm/:courseid` | `readCourse()` + `generateLlms()` | `{ course, llmsLinks }` |
| `/catalogue` | `catalogueService.getCatalogue()` | `{ courseRecords }` |
| `/live` | (none -- uses liveService) | (no data) |
| `/live/:courseid` | `courseService.readCourse()` | `{ courseid, course }` |

**Key observations for test planning:**

1. All `(course-reader)` routes have `ssr = false`, meaning they are client-only. The `(live)` routes for `/catalogue` and `/live/:courseid` do NOT disable SSR.

2. The primary data gateway is `courseService.readCourse()` which fetches `tutors.json` from a URL derived from the `courseid` param. Every course-reader route depends on this. Mocking this single fetch in E2E tests would cover the data loading path for all course-reader routes.

3. Auth data flows from `hooks.server.ts` (GitHub OAuth via `@auth/sveltekit`) through `+layout.server.ts` (which extracts `{ loggedIn, user }`) and into the root `+layout.svelte` (which calls `tutorsConnectService.reconnect(data.user)` when a user exists).

4. Real-time features (live, presence) use PartyKit WebSockets (`PartySocket`) and Supabase. The client hooks file (`hooks.client.ts`) initializes the Supabase client before any load functions run.

5. Global reactive state lives in `src/lib/runes.svelte.ts`: `currentCourse`, `currentLo`, `currentLabStepIndex`, `tutorsId`, `courseProtocol`, `hideMainNavigator`. Many load functions set these as side effects, which the layout components then read reactively.

6. There are no `+error.svelte`, `+server.ts`, or `+layout.ts` files anywhere in the routes tree -- error handling falls to SvelteKit defaults, and there are no API routes.

- Sets a global fallback `__TUTORS_TIME_SUPABASE_INIT__` with `PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` and `PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` before any other imports, so that if `getSupabase()` is called before `initSupabase()`, the library can recover.
- Calls `initSupabase(PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY)` from `@tutors/tutors-time-lib`.
- This runs before any client-side load functions.

### 3. Root Layout

**`D:\code\tutors-apps\src\routes\+layout.server.ts`**
- Load signature: `async ({ locals }) => { ... }`
- Calls `locals.auth()` (provided by the auth hook).
- Returns: `{ loggedIn: boolean, user: Session["user"] | undefined }`
- This data is available to every page via `parent()` or automatic cascading.

**`D:\code\tutors-apps\src\routes\+layout.svelte`**
- Props: `{ data: PageData, children: Snippet }`
- If `data.user` is truthy, calls `tutorsConnectService.reconnect(data.user)` to restore the user session on the client.
- If running in browser, calls `themeService.initDisplay()`.
- Renders `{@render children()}` with no wrapping shell (the group layouts add the shell).

### 4. Route Group Layouts

#### `(home)` group -- `D:\code\tutors-apps\src\routes\(home)\+layout.svelte`
- Resets `currentCourse.value = null`.
- Wraps children in `<CourseShell>` (the `TutorsShell.svelte` component).
- Sets page title to "Tutors".

#### `(course-reader)` group -- `D:\code\tutors-apps\src\routes\(course-reader)\+layout.svelte`
- Calls `tutorsConnectService.startTimer()` on mount.
- Has a `$effect` that fires on every navigation, calling `tutorsConnectService.learningEvent(page.params)`.
- On course change (when `currentCourse.value.courseId` differs from `lastCourseId`), calls `tutorsConnectService.checkWhiteList()` and `tutorsConnectService.courseVisit(currentCourse.value)`.
- After navigation, smooth-scrolls `#content-panel` into view on viewports >= 600px.
- Sets `<title>` to `currentCourse.value.title`.
- Wraps children in `<CourseShell>`.

#### `(live)` group -- `D:\code\tutors-apps\src\routes\(live)\+layout.svelte`
- Resets `currentCourse.value = null`.
- On mount, fetches `catalogueService.getCatalogueCount()` and `catalogueService.getStudentCount()` (though these values are only used locally and not passed down).
- Sets page title to "Tutors".
- Wraps children in `<CourseShell>` inside a bordered/rounded container div.

### 5. All Routes -- Load Functions and Page Components

#### 5.1 `(home)/` -- Home Page
- **Route**: `/`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `ssr = false`. Calls `parent()` but returns nothing (`async ({ parent }) => {}`). The page only inherits the root layout data (`loggedIn`, `user`).
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Does not receive `data` prop. Renders four sub-components: `Welcome`, `TutorsInfo`, `Links`, `CourseList`. All data for these comes from services or runes, not from the load function.

#### 5.2 `(auth)/auth` -- Sign-In (no course context)
- **Route**: `/auth`
- **Load**: None (`+page.ts` does not exist).
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Renders `<SigninWithGithub redirect={"/"} />`. No data props.

#### 5.3 `(auth)/auth/[courseid]` -- Sign-In with Redirect to Course
- **Route**: `/auth/:courseid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `async ({ params }) => { return { courseId: params.courseid }; }`
- **Returns**: `{ courseId: string }`
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: any }`. Renders `<SigninWithGithub redirect="/course/{data.courseId}" />`.

#### 5.4 `(course-reader)/course/[courseid]` -- Course Home
- **Route**: `/course/:courseid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `ssr = false`. Calls `courseService.readCourse(params.courseid, fetch)`. Sets `currentCourse.value = course`.
- **Returns**: `{ course: Course, lo: Course }` (both are the same Course object)
- **Service call**: `courseService.readCourse()` -- fetches `tutors.json`, builds and caches the course tree.
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: any }`. Renders `<Composite composite={data.course} />`.

#### 5.5 `(course-reader)/topic/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Topic View
- **Route**: `/topic/:courseid/*loid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `ssr = false`. Calls `courseService.readTopic(params.courseid, url.pathname, fetch)`.
- **Returns**: `{ topic: Topic }`
- **Service call**: `courseService.readTopic()` -- loads the course, then looks up the topic from `course.topicIndex` by URL pathname.
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: PageData }`. Renders `<Composite composite={data.topic} />`.

#### 5.6 `(course-reader)/lab/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Lab View
- **Route**: `/lab/:courseid/*loid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `ssr = false`. Calls `courseService.readLab(params.courseid, url.pathname, fetch)`. Determines whether to set the first page active or a specific page based on the last URL segment. Sets `currentLabStepIndex.value`.
- **Returns**: `{ lab: LabService }` (a `LiveLab` instance)
- **Service call**: `courseService.readLab()` -- loads the course, strips the step segment from the lab ID, looks up the lab from `course.loIndex`, converts markdown to HTML, creates/caches a `LiveLab`.
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: PageData }`. If `data.lab.lab.pdf` is truthy, renders a `TalkClient` inside `Context`; otherwise renders a `Lab` inside `Context`. Sets `hideMainNavigator` rune to `true` on mount / `false` on destroy.

#### 5.7 `(course-reader)/talk/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Talk/Presentation
- **Route**: `/talk/:courseid/*loid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `ssr = false`. Calls `courseService.readLo(params.courseid, url.pathname, fetch)`.
- **Returns**: `{ lo: Lo }`
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: PageData }`. Renders `<Context lo={data.lo}><TalkClient lo={data.lo} /></Context>`.

#### 5.8 `(course-reader)/paneltalk/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Panel Talk
- **Route**: `/paneltalk/:courseid/*loid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): Identical to talk -- `ssr = false`, calls `courseService.readLo(params.courseid, url.pathname, fetch)`.
- **Returns**: `{ lo: Lo }`
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Identical rendering to talk -- `<Context lo={data.lo}><TalkClient lo={data.lo} /></Context>`.

#### 5.9 `(course-reader)/note/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Note
- **Route**: `/note/:courseid/*loid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `ssr = false`. Calls `courseService.readLo(params.courseid, url.pathname, fetch)`.
- **Returns**: `{ lo: Lo }`
- **Service call**: `courseService.readLo()` -- if the LO type is `"note"`, also calls `markdownService.convertNoteToHtml()` and caches it.
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: PageData }`. Renders `<Context lo={data.lo}><Note lo={data.lo} /></Context>`.

#### 5.10 `(course-reader)/tutorial/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Tutorial (Note variant)
- **Route**: `/tutorial/:courseid/*loid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `ssr = false`. Calls `courseService.readLo(params.courseid, url.pathname, fetch)`.
- **Returns**: `{ lo: Lo }`
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: PageData }`. Renders `<Context lo={data.lo}>`, then `<Note lo={data.lo} />`, and conditionally `<TalkClient lo={data.lo} orientation="portrait" />` if `data.lo.pdf` is truthy.

#### 5.11 `(course-reader)/video/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Video
- **Route**: `/video/:courseid/*loid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `ssr = false`. Parses `url.searchParams` to reconstruct the video ID (handles trailing `=` in query strings). Calls `courseService.readLo(params.courseid, videoId, fetch)`.
- **Returns**: `{ lo: Lo }`
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: PageData }`. Renders `<Context lo={data.lo}><Video lo={data.lo} /></Context>`.

#### 5.12 `(course-reader)/wall/[type]/[courseid]` -- Wall (All LOs of a Type)
- **Route**: `/wall/:type/:courseid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `ssr = false`. Calls `courseService.readCourse(params.courseid, fetch)` and `courseService.readWall(params.courseid, params.type, fetch)`. Sets `currentLo.value` to a synthetic object with `breadCrumbs`, `title`, `type`, `parentLo`, `parentCourse`, `route`.
- **Returns**: `{ type: string, lo: Course, los: Lo[] }`
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: PageData }`. Renders `<Wall los={data.los} type={data.type} />`.

#### 5.13 `(course-reader)/search/[courseid]` -- Course Search
- **Route**: `/search/:courseid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `ssr = false`. Calls `courseService.readCourse(params.courseid, fetch)`. Sets `currentLo.value = course`.
- **Returns**: `{ course: Course }`
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: PageData }`. On mount, filters the course LOs into labs, steps, notes, and panel notes. Provides a text input and search button; on submit, calls `searchHits(searchLos, searchTerm)` and renders results with markdown-to-HTML conversion.

#### 5.14 `(course-reader)/time/[courseid]` -- Student Time/Calendar
- **Route**: `/time/:courseid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `ssr = false`. Calls `courseService.readCourse(params.courseid, fetch)`. Sets `currentCourse.value = course`.
- **Returns**: `{ course: Course, lo: Course }` (same object in both fields)
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: any }`. Uses a `$effect` to reactively load student time data via `TutorsTime.loadStudentTime(courseId, studentLogin, null, null)` from `@tutors/tutors-time-lib` when `currentCourse` or `tutorsId` changes. Renders `SecondaryNavigator`, `HeatMaps`, and `Tables` components.

#### 5.15 `(course-reader)/llm/[courseid]` -- LLM Documentation Links
- **Route**: `/llm/:courseid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): `ssr = false`. Calls `courseService.readCourse(params.courseid, fetch)`. Sets `currentCourse.value = course`. Calls `generateLlms(course)` (from local `llms.ts`) which produces HTML links to `llms.txt` and PDF zip archives for the course and each topic.
- **Returns**: `{ course: Course, llmsLinks: string }` (llmsLinks is an HTML string)
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: any }`. If `data.course.llm === 0`, redirects to `/course/:courseid`. Otherwise renders a `SecondaryNavigator` and the LLM documentation links as HTML.

#### 5.16 `(live)/catalogue` -- Course Catalogue
- **Route**: `/catalogue`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): SSR is enabled (no `ssr = false`). Calls `catalogueService.getCatalogue()` (Supabase query on `tutors-connect-courses`). Filters entries with `visit_count >= 20`, sorts descending by visit count. Maps to course records with a `visits` field added.
- **Returns**: `{ courseRecords: Array<{ ...course_record, visits: number }> }`
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: any }`. On mount, computes `totalModules` from `data.courseRecords.length` and fetches `totalStudents` from `catalogueService.getStudentCount()`. Renders `<Catalogue courseRecords={data.courseRecords} />`.

#### 5.17 `(live)/live` -- Global Live View
- **Route**: `/live`
- **Load**: None (`+page.ts` does not exist).
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): No data props. Calls `liveService.startGlobalPresenceService()` at module level. Renders a tabbed view with three tabs: "Courses" (`liveService.coursesOnline`), "Students" (`liveService.studentsOnline`), and "Groups". All data comes from the `liveService` reactive state, not from a load function.

#### 5.18 `(live)/live/[courseid]` -- Course-Specific Live View
- **Route**: `/live/:courseid`
- **Load** (`+page.ts`): SSR enabled. Calls `courseService.readCourse(params.courseid, fetch)`. Sets `currentCourse.value = course`.
- **Returns**: `{ courseid: string, course: Course }`
- **Page** (`+page.svelte`): Props `{ data: { courseid: string, course: Course } }`. On mount, starts `presenceService.startPresenceListener(courseid)` and fetches `getTutorsConnectLatestLosByCourseId(courseid)` from Supabase. Uses `$derived` to partition activity into "today", "this week", "this month", "this year" buckets. Renders `CourseGroupHeader`, `ConnectLatestLosCards` for online students, and a tabbed view for historical activity.

### 6. Summary of Data Flow Patterns

**Service call matrix** (what each route calls):

| Route | Service Method | Returns |
|---|---|---|
| `/` | (none) | `{}` |
| `/auth` | (none) | (no data) |
| `/auth/:courseid` | (none) | `{ courseId }` |
| `/course/:courseid` | `courseService.readCourse()` | `{ course, lo }` |
| `/topic/:courseid/*` | `courseService.readTopic()` | `{ topic }` |
| `/lab/:courseid/*` | `courseService.readLab()` | `{ lab }` |
| `/talk/:courseid/*` | `courseService.readLo()` | `{ lo }` |
| `/paneltalk/:courseid/*` | `courseService.readLo()` | `{ lo }` |
| `/note/:courseid/*` | `courseService.readLo()` | `{ lo }` |
| `/tutorial/:courseid/*` | `courseService.readLo()` | `{ lo }` |
| `/video/:courseid/*` | `courseService.readLo()` | `{ lo }` |
| `/wall/:type/:courseid` | `readCourse()` + `readWall()` | `{ type, lo, los }` |
| `/search/:courseid` | `courseService.readCourse()` | `{ course }` |
| `/time/:courseid` | `courseService.readCourse()` | `{ course, lo }` |
| `/llm/:courseid` | `readCourse()` + `generateLlms()` | `{ course, llmsLinks }` |
| `/catalogue` | `catalogueService.getCatalogue()` | `{ courseRecords }` |
| `/live` | (none -- uses liveService) | (no data) |
| `/live/:courseid` | `courseService.readCourse()` | `{ courseid, course }` |

**Key observations for test planning:**

1. All `(course-reader)` routes have `ssr = false`, meaning they are client-only. The `(live)` routes for `/catalogue` and `/live/:courseid` do NOT disable SSR.

2. The primary data gateway is `courseService.readCourse()` which fetches `tutors.json` from a URL derived from the `courseid` param. Every course-reader route depends on this. Mocking this single fetch in E2E tests would cover the data loading path for all course-reader routes.

3. Auth data flows from `hooks.server.ts` (GitHub OAuth via `@auth/sveltekit`) through `+layout.server.ts` (which extracts `{ loggedIn, user }`) and into the root `+layout.svelte` (which calls `tutorsConnectService.reconnect(data.user)` when a user exists).

4. Real-time features (live, presence) use PartyKit WebSockets (`PartySocket`) and Supabase. The client hooks file (`hooks.client.ts`) initializes the Supabase client before any load functions run.

5. Global reactive state lives in `src/lib/runes.svelte.ts`: `currentCourse`, `currentLo`, `currentLabStepIndex`, `tutorsId`, `courseProtocol`, `hideMainNavigator`. Many load functions set these as side effects, which the layout components then read reactively.

6. There are no `+error.svelte`, `+server.ts`, or `+layout.ts` files anywhere in the routes tree -- error handling falls to SvelteKit defaults, and there are no API routes.
